message.content: {"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"WGES 2026 will discuss governance to accelerate the green transition.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,3,4]},{"claim":"The 12th World Green Economy Summit (WGES) will be held on 21 and 22 October 2026 in Dubai.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The summit will focus on policies, regulation, and governance to accelerate the global transition to a green economy.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The event is organized by the Dubai Supreme Council of Energy, DEWA, and the World Green Economy Organization.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"The main themes of the summit are energy technology, business strategies, water and food security, and finance.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"Special attention will be given to artificial intelligence and governance issues.","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"Participants will discuss the influence of policy on markets, the development of carbon markets, and the role of international climate agreements.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Экономист BlackRock Эхсан Хоман отметил, что фундаментальные факторы, поддерживающие привлекательность ОАЭ для мировых инвесторов, остаются стабильными.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"Экономика демонстрирует устойчивость.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"Важную роль продолжают играть секторы торговли, туризма и транспорта.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"В ближайшие 3-5 лет в стране ожидается рост новых секторов, особенно в области искусственного интеллекта.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"Развивается инфраструктура для ИИ, включая производство чипов и компонентов для дата-центров.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"Это отражает стратегию ОАЭ по ускорению технологической трансформации.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"GOTECH 2026 concluded in Dubai.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"GOTECH 2026 was an international conference and exhibition.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"GOTECH 2026 gathered more than 2600 participants from 70 countries and 1206 companies.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"The event focused on innovation, artificial intelligence, and sustainability in the oil and gas industry.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"The three-day program discussed key topics including digital transformation, operational optimization, and environmental safety.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,3,4]},{"claim":"A special educational program was organized for students from the UAE.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text passages.","claims":[{"claim":"Microsoft presented the Digital Defence Report 2026 during Cyber Security month.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The report notes the rise of threats and the importance of artificial intelligence in data protection.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,8,9,10]},{"claim":"The UAE ranked 6th globally in the number of cyberattacks in the first half of 2026.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"The UAE ranked 2nd in the Middle East and Africa region for cyberattacks in the first half of 2026.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"Microsoft, the UAE Cyber Security Council, and Core42 plan to implement the AI solution MDASH for government entities in the UAE.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,4]},{"claim":"MDASH will help identify vulnerabilities faster and respond to threats while considering sovereignty and privacy requirements.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]},{"claim":"Yazan Khasawneh, Director of Cyber Security at Microsoft UAE, stated that cybersecurity must be integrated into AI adoption and identity management from the start.","supported":true,"evidence":[4,5,6,7]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source passages.","claims":[{"claim":"A paid parking system will start operating at Al Zahra Hospital in Dubai from October 15.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The paid parking system is for visitors and patients.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The system is managed by the company Parkonic.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"Parkonic requires parking validation before leaving the hospital.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,8]},{"claim":"Outpatients receive up to four hours of free parking.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]},{"claim":"Visitors to the emergency department receive up to six hours of free parking.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]},{"claim":"Additional parking time is charged at 10 dirhams per hour.","supported":true,"evidence":[6]},{"claim":"Vehicles without required validation are charged 50 dirhams per hour.","supported":true,"evidence":[6]},{"claim":"Payment is automatically deducted from the Salik account linked to the vehicle.","supported":true,"evidence":[7]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"The Dubai International Electric Vehicle Exhibition and Conference 2026 (EV World 2026) will be held from 10 to 12 November 2026 at Dubai World Trade Centre.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The event is the inaugural edition of the Dubai International Electric Vehicle Exhibition and Conference.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"The event is organized by the Roads and Transport Authority (RTA).","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The event will attract more than 300 companies and 10,000 specialists.","supported":true,"evidence":[6]},{"claim":"The exhibition will be a platform for exchanging expertise and showcasing the latest technologies in electric vehicles, hydrogen engines, charging infrastructure, and autonomous systems.","supported":true,"evidence":[4,6,8]},{"claim":"RTA continues to implement the 'Zero-Emissions Public Transportation in Dubai 2050' strategy.","supported":true,"evidence":[4,8,12]},{"claim":"RTA is expanding the fleet of environmentally friendly taxis and buses and developing infrastructure for electric vehicles.","supported":true,"evidence":[8,9,10,11]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Dubai has launched an agentic AI accelerator program to transform government services and shorten development times.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1,3]},{"claim":"In the first phase, 33 government entities will participate and assess more than 300 AI use cases.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]},{"claim":"The project is organized by the Dubai Centre for Artificial Intelligence in collaboration with Digital Dubai and the Dubai Electronic Security Centre.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]},{"claim":"Agentic AI can independently make decisions and correct errors in real time, enabling it to perform complex tasks without constant human supervision.","supported":true,"evidence":[7,8,11,12]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Dubai Supreme Council of Energy highlighted the importance of safety and compliance standards in petroleum products trading, including storage, transport, and distribution.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1,2]},{"claim":"This is part of efforts to ensure safe and efficient operations in the sector.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"The Council urges companies to use only licensed facilities and transport that meet requirements, and to strictly follow safety procedures and technical standards.","supported":true,"evidence":[6,7,9,10,11,12,13]},{"claim":"Since 2022, 449 joint inspections have been conducted in the liquefied petroleum gas sector to combat illegal activities and enhance safety.","supported":true,"evidence":[16,17]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"DIB и Expo City Dubai запускают финансирование жилья на этапе строительства","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"DIB, крупнейший исламский банк ОАЭ, заключил стратегическое партнерство с Expo City Dubai для предоставления финансирования на покупку недвижимости в строящихся объектах","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"Программа позволяет финансировать до 50% стоимости жилья после 35% завершения строительства и оплаты покупателем половины цены","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"Финансирование доступно на срок до 25 лет для граждан и резидентов ОАЭ без требования перевода зарплаты","supported":true,"evidence":[5,6]},{"claim":"Клиенты платят только прибыль в период строительства, а полные ежемесячные платежи начинаются при передаче ключей или через 24 месяца после получения финансирования","supported":true,"evidence":[4,8]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Dubai and World Cities Culture Forum announced the launch of Global Fellowship.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"Global Fellowship program will bring together 20 professionals from different cities, including five representatives from Dubai organizations.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,4,22]},{"claim":"The program aims to develop skills in cultural policy and urban leadership.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"Participants will study, exchange experience, and develop projects for their cities over six months.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,5,17,18]},{"claim":"From November 2026 to March 2027, online masterclasses will be held.","supported":true,"evidence":[16,17]},{"claim":"In spring 2027, a five-day residency will take place in Dubai.","supported":true,"evidence":[19,20]},{"claim":"The program is aimed at strengthening the role of culture in sustainable urban development and improving quality of life.","supported":true,"evidence":[9,10,21]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"In Dubai, a project has started to implement a unified visual identity and enhanced addressing system covering 186 areas.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,3]},{"claim":"The initiative includes installation of new area identification signs, street name signs, and house number plates reflecting geographic features of each area.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,6]},{"claim":"The first phase will start in the fourth quarter of 2026 and cover more than 2000 signs in five areas including Za’abeel and Nad Al Sheba.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,4]},{"claim":"The colors of the signs are chosen according to the character of the areas, for example, blue for coastal zones and gold for desert areas.","supported":true,"evidence":[5,6]},{"claim":"In the future, the system will expand to bus stops and digital applications with QR codes for the convenience of residents and visitors.","supported":true,"evidence":[7,8]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"The 15th season of Dubai Miracle Garden has started in Dubai.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"Dubai Miracle Garden is the world's largest natural flower garden.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The 15th season is under the theme 'Fifteen Years, Blooming Together'.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The season will last until 31 May 2027.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,7]},{"claim":"The season will feature more than 200 million flowers across 72,000 square metres.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Each week will have a new theme reflecting the national and cultural calendar of the UAE.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,3]},{"claim":"The weekly themes include events dedicated to Pink October, United Nations Day, UAE Flag Day, and Diwali.","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"The program includes live music, family activities, and sports events as part of the Dubai Fitness Challenge.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Dubai Municipality launched the initiative ‘A Generation for a Greater Tomorrow’.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"The initiative takes place from 7 to 11 October at City Centre Mirdif.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"The initiative offers an interactive experience introducing children to municipal work and the importance of city services for everyday life.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,3]},{"claim":"The program includes educational stations on agriculture, safety, communications, digital games, and laboratory experiments.","supported":true,"evidence":[4,5,6]},{"claim":"The initiative supports the UAE’s Year of the Family by encouraging joint participation of children and parents.","supported":true,"evidence":[3]}]}
